purpose: Second regional combat pass covering support items and permanent combat benefits already present elsewhere in research but missing from the region-facing catalog.

policy.region_rule: Only attach a hard required region when the acquisition source is genuinely region-bound. Unresolved one-of mappings stay unresolved.
policy.current_rule: Use post-2026 Dungeoneering and Aura Overhaul values where those systems changed.
policy.duplicate_rule: These records intentionally share IDs with existing permanent-unlock research where appropriate so normalization preserves one dependency graph while the region catalog gains the missing visibility.

activity_additions.name: Guthix staff and Claws of Guthix access
requirements: Complete the Mage Arena encounter and choose Guthix for the initial reward
Cast Divine Storm 100 times on Mage Arena mages for the extended unlock
unlocks: Divine Storm outside the Mage Arena
activity_additions.league_treatment: Mage Arena is Wilderness geography, so Forinthry is the normal acquisition region unless Equilibrium publishes an exception.

activity_additions.name: Dreadnips
requirements: Spectate another player's Dominion Tower match
unlocks: Ability to claim and deploy Dreadnips
activity_additions.league_treatment: Track the permanent reward gate without importing old boss-use or damage advice.

equipment_additions.name: Holy wrench
quest_dependencies: Pieces of Hate for the Dungeoneering prayer-necklace interaction
effects: Increases Prayer restored by supported prayer-restoring potions while carried or worn
After Pieces of Hate, Dungeoneering prayer necklaces restore 10% more Prayer
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Morytania supplies the normal gameplay acquisition. Resolve the quests through the Equilibrium quest overlay separately.

equipment_additions.name: Demon horn necklace
effects: Restores 50 to 150 Prayer points when qualifying bones are buried or supported ashes/ghost remains are processed with the attuned ectoplasmator
equipment_additions.notes: The 11 May 2026 Dungeoneering remaster reduced the Dungeoneering requirement from 90 to 75 while retaining the 35,000-token cost.

equipment_additions.name: Split dragontooth necklace
effects: Restores Prayer from qualifying buried bones and works with Bonecrusher-processed bones
equipment_additions.notes: The 11 May 2026 remaster reduced its Dungeoneering requirement to 41 and token cost to 15,500.

equipment_additions.name: Asylum surgeon's ring
requirements: Complete a replay in under 37 minutes
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Show both possible region mappings without claiming both are required. Official Equilibrium quest locality can resolve this later.

account_additions.name: Ring of Vigour and passive conversion
requirements: 50,000 Dungeoneering tokens for the base ring
Extinction for the warped-gem passive conversion in the normal game
effects: Retains 10% adrenaline after using an ultimate ability
Warped-gem conversion makes the effect permanently active without equipping the ring
account_additions.league_treatment: Forinthry is the normal base-ring source. Treat Extinction as a separate quest-auto-completion dependency rather than a second elective region.

account_additions.name: Bonecrusher
account_additions.category: post-remaster combat drop-cleaner and Prayer sustain infrastructure
effects: Automatically converts configured bone drops into normal burying Prayer XP
Combines with Dungeoneering prayer necklaces for Prayer sustain
account_additions.notes: Use the 11 May 2026 remaster cost and requirement, not the older 34,000-token version.

account_additions.name: Charming imp
effects: Automatically collects charms and spirit gems; selected charm types can instead be converted into Summoning XP
account_additions.notes: This is especially relevant to the listed Waterbirth Dagannoth charm-farming method.

account_additions.name: NopeNopeNope spider combat perk
requirements: Spider breeding-log progression at Manor Farm
effects: Tier 1 permanent breeding-log perk: 2% increased damage against all spiders including Araxxor/Araxxi
Tier 2 farm-totem configuration: 3% increased damage against all spiders including Araxxor/Araxxi

Tier 2: 10% chance to conserve a bomb when thrown
